root_text:
@SaskiaPopescu It's also spread by aerosols, which are the primary infectious route of the deluge of respiratory viruses we are currently facing. SARS, RSV, Influenza, Mycoplasma, HMPV, Whopping cough. 
Wear an N95 masks and avoid them all.
